scope: Recorded proposal activation on captured live input only, not host execution or strength. Live Lv 8 Deity Korea Online turns on which border-parity bought a unit 'to hold parity', each run's events.jsonl cut at the turn's first state frame and queried with the run's own requested genome on a frozen ci-profile civvis_orders built from the branch. Every listed off arm reproduces the live purchase (UNIT_WARRIOR x3, UNIT_ARCHER, UNIT_HEAVY_CHARIOT); every on arm buys nothing: three with the rival at 2.3-4.3x our power (out of reach), two buying a unit two eras behind the world. No upgrade was affordable above the parity reserve on these boards.
